[attribute-nav-pointer-type]
=== `@nav-pointer-type` Type of Navigation Pointer

Indicates the kind of navigation pointer (<<element-nav-pointer,`<nav-pointer>`>>) being used in a structural index entry, i.e., the pointer could identify a single page (value “`point`”) in the narrative text, or the beginning and end of a page range (values “`start-of-range`” and “`end-of-range`” respectively).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-nav-pointer,`<nav-pointer>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| end-of-range| The end of a page range.
| point| A single page.
| start-of-range| The start of a page range.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
